219:t_016:5.en:
$$バサラ$$
「...I can't put it into words...! But something's bothering me!」

219:t_100:0.en:
$$レド$$
「I never thought the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$' habitat extended all the way here...!」

219:t_100:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The expansion of fighting in the galactic center is the presumed cause.」

219:t_100:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Then we'll strike before they reproduce any further...! This universe belongs to humanity!」

219:t_101:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Damn $$バジュラ$$. They attack us and the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ indiscriminately.」

219:t_101:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. Insufficient data on the swarm currently engaged.」

219:t_101:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Collect it as we fight. That's what we did on Earth.」

219:t_101:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. Executing your instructions.」

219:t_102:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「First we were trapped in the $$地球圏$$, and now we're forced into the middle of the galaxy...!」

219:t_102:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Like hell I'll die out here! We've still got unfinished business on Earth!」

219:t_103:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「The middle of the galaxy is my stage! Now this gets me fired up!」

219:t_103:1.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「He doesn't understand how serious this is at all!」

219:t_103:2.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「But at times like this, his steadiness is reassuring too.」

219:t_103:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Quit chattering! The concert's already started!」

219:t_103:5.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Honestly! You're just not thinking at all!」

219:t_104:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
(The galactic center... It really drives home how small humans are...)

219:t_104:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
(I can't die yet, $$ララァ$$...)

219:t_105:0.en:
$$シャア$$
(I never thought I'd feel the vastness of space again like this...)

219:t_105:1.en:
$$シャア$$
($$ララァ$$... This expanding awareness... I wish I could convey it to all of humanity...!)

219:t_106:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(I feel my awareness expanding... Are my $$ニュータイプ$$ abilities growing?)

219:t_106:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(This is true space... Will the people of Earth eventually make this their home too...?)

219:t_107:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
(So this is the galaxy... The infinite vastness of space...)

219:t_107:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
(What is this feeling...? Our situation might be hopeless, yet my heart is racing...)

219:t_107:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$オードリー$$... I want to share what I'm feeling with you...!)

219:t_108:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「With energy from the $$クォーター$$, I can fire the $$サテライトキャノン$$ once every two minutes! I'll make it work!」

219:t_108:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm going to survive! And I'm definitely going back to Earth with $$ティファ$$!」

219:t_109:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Miss $$ソシエ$$, Miss $$キエル$$... And Lady $$ディアナ$$... I've... come so far away...)

219:t_109:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Lady $$ディアナ$$ once said that the $$ムーンレィス$$ were a people who could never give up their longing for Earth.)

219:t_109:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
(I'm the same. Whatever hardships await, I'll return to the Earth where you're all waiting...!)

219:t_110:0.en:
$$シン$$
「A sea of stars with the space whales from the book I read as a kid... I never thought I'd come here like this...」

219:t_110:1.en:
$$シン$$
「But I have a wish to stop war! I'm going back to Earth!」

219:t_111:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「There's fighting in the galaxy too... A fight for survival, different from the fighting on Earth...」

219:t_111:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「I have to live...! There's something I need to do on Earth!」

219:t_112:0.en:
$$刹那$$
(That strange feeling I had earlier... What was it...?)

219:t_112:1.en:
$$刹那$$
(What... do I want to do...?)

219:t_113:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It's huge...! Space is so huge!」

219:t_113:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I-I don't know why, but I really feel like shouting!」

219:t_114:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
(During that $$時空震動$$... my $$スフィア$$ reacted to something...)

219:t_114:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I have a bad feeling... Something is about to happen...)

219:t_115:0.en:
$n
(I'm sorry, $$宗介$$... I couldn't save you and $$千鳥$$...)

219:t_115:1.en:
$n
(But it's not over yet...! I... We are going back to Earth!)

219:t_115:2.en:
$n
(And we'll do it...! We'll save $$千鳥$$, no matter what!)
